title: Recurring VPN timeout - remote sales team
symptoms: Users on SSL VPN disconnect every 15-20 minutes during peak hours (9-11am).
root_cause: VPN concentrator idle-timeout set below client keep-alive interval; NAT table exhaustion on edge firewall during peak concurrent sessions.
resolution: 1) Raise idle-timeout to 45 min on concentrator policy. 2) Increase NAT table size on edge firewall. 3) Set VPN client keep-alive to 5 min. 4) Monitor concurrent sessions for 1 week.

title: VPN client connects but internal resources unreachable
symptoms: VPN shows connected but users cannot open file shares or intranet; internal hostnames fail to resolve.
root_cause: Split-tunnel DNS suffix list missing after VPN profile update; clients using home router DNS.
resolution: 1) Push internal DNS servers and suffix list in VPN profile. 2) Have users reconnect. 3) Verify with nslookup against internal DNS. 4) Add profile change to change-review checklist.

title: AD replication failure between DC02 and DC05
symptoms: Event ID 1988 lagging objects; new user accounts not visible on DC05 for 2+ hours; repadmin /showrepl shows failures.
root_cause: USN rollback caused by DC05 restore from an unsupported VM snapshot.
resolution: 1) Isolate DC05 from the network. 2) Run metadata cleanup with ntdsutil. 3) Demote and re-promote DC05. 4) Disable snapshot-based backups for DCs and use AD-aware backup tooling.

title: Password authentication failures after domain password reset
symptoms: Users receive 'incorrect password' after resetting their password; works on some machines, fails on others for about 30 minutes.
root_cause: Password change not replicated to all domain controllers promptly because of a stale AD site-link replication schedule.
resolution: 1) Run repadmin /syncall. 2) Set site-link replication interval to 15 min. 3) Ask users to lock/unlock workstation to refresh credentials. 4) Monitor replication latency.

title: Users cannot authenticate after MFA enrollment
symptoms: After enrolling in MFA, sign-in loops back to the prompt or reports 'verification failed'; authenticator codes are rejected.
root_cause: Device clock drift of several minutes made TOTP codes invalid; some users also had legacy per-user MFA state conflicting with the Conditional Access policy.
resolution: 1) Sync device time with NTP. 2) Reset the user's MFA registration and re-enroll. 3) Disable legacy per-user MFA and rely on Conditional Access. 4) Verify sign-in logs show MFA satisfied.

title: Microsoft 365 login failure - repeated credential prompts
symptoms: Outlook and Teams repeatedly prompt for credentials; browser login to office.com succeeds.
root_cause: Stale cached tokens in Windows Credential Manager and a corrupted Office identity cache after a password change.
resolution: 1) Sign out of Office apps. 2) Clear Office entries in Credential Manager. 3) Delete the identity cache folder. 4) Sign in again and confirm modern authentication is enabled.

title: Exchange Online mailbox full - users cannot send mail
symptoms: Users receive 'mailbox full' bounces and cannot send or receive mail.
root_cause: Mailbox reached quota; online archive not enabled and retention policy not applied.
resolution: 1) Temporarily raise quota. 2) Enable online archive. 3) Apply retention policy to move old items. 4) Educate user on mailbox cleanup.

title: Laptop boot loop after Windows update
symptoms: Dozens of laptops stuck in a reboot loop after the monthly cumulative update.
root_cause: Faulty storage driver shipped with the update conflicts with a specific OEM firmware version.
resolution: 1) Boot to WinRE and uninstall the latest quality update. 2) Pause the update ring for affected models. 3) Update firmware via vendor tool. 4) Re-release the update in a pilot ring first.

title: Endpoint disk space exhausted on user laptops
symptoms: C: drive at 99%; applications crash and updates fail.
root_cause: Temp files, old Windows Update caches and OneDrive offline copies consuming disk.
resolution: 1) Run Disk Cleanup and clear the Windows Update cache. 2) Enable OneDrive Files On-Demand. 3) Remove stale user profiles. 4) Configure Storage Sense via policy.

title: SQL Server connection failures - login timeout
symptoms: Application reports 'connection timeout expired' to SQL Server; intermittent success.
root_cause: Connection pool exhaustion because the application does not close connections, combined with blocking from a long-running transaction.
resolution: 1) Identify the blocking chain with sp_who2 / DMVs. 2) Kill the head blocker. 3) Fix the application to dispose connections. 4) Set connection pool max and query timeout.

title: Database transaction log full
symptoms: Writes fail with error 9002 'transaction log is full'.
root_cause: Full recovery model without log backups; a long-running open transaction prevents log truncation.
resolution: 1) Check log_reuse_wait_desc. 2) Take a transaction log backup. 3) Commit or kill the open transaction. 4) Schedule regular log backups and alert at 80% log usage.

title: Customer portal outage - HTTP 503
symptoms: Customer web portal returns HTTP 503 for all users.
root_cause: Application pool crashed after a memory leak in the latest release; health probe did not remove the failed instance.
resolution: 1) Roll back to the previous release. 2) Recycle the app pool. 3) Fix the health probe to check dependencies. 4) Add memory alerting and canary deploys.

title: Application slow response after deployment
symptoms: Page load times jump from 1s to 12s after a release; no errors logged.
root_cause: Missing database index for a new query introduced in the release, causing a full table scan.
resolution: 1) Check the slow query log. 2) Add the missing index. 3) Add a query performance check to the release pipeline.

title: File server CPU spike at 100%
symptoms: File server CPU pinned at 100%; shares extremely slow.
root_cause: Antivirus real-time scan looping on a large backup folder plus a runaway backup agent process.
resolution: 1) Identify top processes via Task Manager / perfmon. 2) Add scan exclusions for backup paths. 3) Restart the backup agent. 4) Add CPU alert at 85% for 10 minutes.

title: Server disk space low - logs filling volume
symptoms: Application server D: drive at 98%; services stopping.
root_cause: Application debug logging left enabled with no log rotation.
resolution: 1) Archive and delete old logs. 2) Disable debug logging. 3) Configure log rotation and retention. 4) Add disk-space alert at 80%.

title: DNS resolution failures for internal hostnames
symptoms: Internal hostnames fail to resolve intermittently; external sites work.
root_cause: One of two internal DNS servers had a stopped DNS service and stale config; clients still referenced it as primary.
resolution: 1) Restart the DNS service. 2) Verify zone data and forwarders. 3) Reorder the client DNS server list. 4) Monitor DNS service health.

title: Wi-Fi drops in open-plan office
symptoms: Laptops lose Wi-Fi every few minutes in one area of the office.
root_cause: Co-channel interference and an access point running outdated firmware.
resolution: 1) Run a Wi-Fi site survey. 2) Adjust the channel plan. 3) Upgrade AP firmware. 4) Lower AP transmit power in the dense area.

title: Account lockouts every morning
symptoms: Multiple users locked out at the start of the day.
root_cause: Mobile devices and mapped drives using old cached passwords repeatedly hitting the domain controller.
resolution: 1) Use lockout status tooling to find the source. 2) Remove stale mapped drives and update mobile mail profiles. 3) Clear cached credentials. 4) Review lockout threshold policy.

title: SharePoint access denied for new project team
symptoms: New team members get 'access denied' on the project SharePoint site.
root_cause: Users were added to a distribution list instead of the security group backing the site permissions.
resolution: 1) Add users to the correct security group. 2) Wait for group sync. 3) Document the access request procedure. 4) Move to access-package based onboarding.

title: Shared drive permission change locked out finance users
symptoms: Finance team lost access to the finance share after a permissions cleanup.
root_cause: Broken inheritance and removal of a legacy group during cleanup.
resolution: 1) Restore the previous ACL from backup. 2) Re-add the finance security group. 3) Require change approval for ACL cleanup. 4) Run an access review.
